main_text.p: עַדְנָא עִדָּן Ch. ܥܕܢܐ ܥܕܢ Syr. Tempus. Plural. עִדְנִין. עִדָּנֵי. עִדְנַיָּא.
עִדִּין Ch.Idem. Plur. constr. לְעִדּוּנֵי צַפְרָא Tempore matutino, Genes.29.25. in T.Jon.
עָדַף Heb.Excellere, abundare, praestare. Unde עָדִיף Ch. Excellens, praestans, Psal.45.3.
עֲדַר Syr. Juvare, adjuvare, opem ferre, opitulari, auxiliari, prodesse: Hinc Gall. Aider. Pahel ܥܕܪ Idem. Ethpahel ܐܬܥܕܪ Juvari, adjuvari. Ab Hebraeo עזר, ז & ר inter se permutatis.
ܥܕܘܪܐ Syr. Adjumentum, auxilium, commodum, utilitas.
ܥܕܝܪܐ Syr. Adjutor, opitulator, auxiliator, cooperator. Plur. ܥܕܝܪܝܢ.
עֶרְרָא Ch. Grex, tam minorum, quàm majorum animantium. Plur. עֶרְרִין, עֶרְרַיָּא.
מַעְרָא, מַעֲדַר Ch. Sarculus, sarculum, ut Hebr.
עֲדַר Syr. Recordari, memorem esse, meminisse. Aphel ܐܥܕܪ Recordari facere, In memoriā reducere, revocare, commonefacere.
ܡܥܕܪܢܘܬܐ Syr. Memoria, recordatio, 2.ad Timoth.1.5. Cum Aff. ܒܡܥܕܪܢܘܬܟܘܢ Ob recordationem vestri, ad Phil.1.3.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee characters are transcribed only approximately; vowel points and diacritics over the Syriac and Hebrew forms are uncertain and may not match the print exactly. Final Hebrew word at lower right is treated as a catchword.
